VisualCardPool.rationale: `=> ModelDb.CardPool<DefectCardPool>()` (RipAndTear.cs:18) selects the card's ART pool. Presentation.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Event, TargetType.RandomEnemy)` (RipAndTear.cs:20-23) == cost 1 / ATTACK / EVENT / RANDOM_ENEMY. The RANDOM_ENEMY target type is what keeps the framework from resolving a single target up front (sts2_rl/combat.py, only resolves ANY_ENEMY -- re-verify current line before re-citing), leaving the per-hit roll to the card.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(7m, ValueProp.Move)` (RipAndTear.cs:16) == `_damage = 7`; the hit count of 2 is a literal `WithHitCount(2)` in C# (27) rather than a RepeatVar, and the sim stores it as `_hits = 2` so `base_hits` reports it -- the same small improvement card/maul makes.

OnPlay.rationale: Closed 2026-07-27: the per-hit target roll now runs on the named stream. `trash_heap_cards.py:301-309` takes `crng = ctx.combat.combat_rng` and, when `crng.is_parity`, picks with `crng.targets.choice(living)` -- `targets` maps to `combat_targets` (combat_rng.py) -- keeping the shared `random.Random` only on the legacy RL arm, which is the two-branch shape card/sword_boomerang already used and this entry named as the fix. Re-verified current: the `is_parity` branch structure is unchanged. VERIFIED AGAINST THE SOURCE, NOT THE COMMENT: src/Core/Commands/Builders/AttackCommand.cs:601-602 reads `Rng combatTargets = (Attacker.Player ?? Attacker.PetOwner).RunState.Rng.CombatTargets; singleTarget = combatTargets.NextItem(validTargets);` -- one draw on CombatTargets per hit, inside the per-hit loop, which is exactly one `crng.targets.choice` per iteration of `for _ in range(self._hits)`. The per-hit re-derivation of `living` from `is_gone`, the duplicates-allowed policy, and the break when no target remains are all faithful. Legacy mode is byte-identical to before, because `CombatRng.legacy` hands every accessor the same `random.Random` the else-arm uses (combat_rng.py, wired at run.py:1709/combat.py:153). REGRESSION TEST: `test/test_rng_tripwire.py` (`test_no_wrong_stream_draws_in_random_run`, 20 seeded full runs, re-verify presence before citing a line) is the standing gate for this whole family. It wraps `RunState.rng` and asserts ZERO in-combat draws on it; `CombatState` receives that same object as `self._rng` (run.py:1709, combat.py:153). The gate is green today.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Damage.UpgradeValueBy(2m)` (RipAndTear.cs:35) == `self._damage += 2` (7 -> 9). The hit count stays 2 when upgraded on both sides.
